description: This Java source file defines the MergedBlockMetaRequest class, which represents a network protocol message used to request meta information about merged blocks in Spark. It includes fields for request ID, application ID, shuffle ID, shuffle merge ID, and reduce ID, along with methods for encoding, decoding, and comparison.
